race.comment: FILTHY (1) has had only three starts and brings the most appealing recent form. Couldn't get the job done as fav last time but was strong late. The rise to 1400m should suit him perfectly fourth-up and he can get off the mark this time. CAUTIONARY TAIL (12) finds the maiden win elusive but looks one of the main dangers after being beaten just under a length at Lismore where he had excuses. The weight relief strengthens his case. CREDIBILITY (2) had genuine excuses when fifth on the poly here as favourite and his Grafton second keeps him right in the mix. RISING QUEEN (9) improved sharply when second at Sunshine Coast and has placed at this distance, making her a sound hope if she repeats that latest run. OVER THE LOUVRE (5) has been okay in both runs back and should be further improved third-up.
